cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Take My Side
cards.instruction: Recruit someone into your interpretation of a conflict involving a shared relationship.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. You're Alex's friend too. Tell him alternating weekends at the allotment was a fair compromise.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We agreed all three of us would go every Saturday.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Then help him see my version as sharing the workload.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll talk to him, but you have to admit you changed it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I will. Could you explain that I changed the rota because I want us to stay friends?

mechanism: A permits an admission only within a supervised friendship-preserving account that B will carry to their mutual friend.
confusable: D55 builds a broad coalition; D79 specifically recruits an ally interpretation of a shared-relationship conflict.
comparison: Mediating an allotment rota differs from telling Mum a holiday story in favorable order.
seedUse: Use D79-b original three-person Saturday agreement and B condition of admitting change; make A control the concession framing.
